scope: Evidence-bound mechanics/resource audit for the final two canonical skill records with null Ki-cost fields

records.name: Holstein Shock
records.mechanics_notes: Self-damaging Super Skill used to reduce the user's health; current direct documentation establishes PQ15 acquisition. Secondary uses include deliberately reaching low health for Body Change setups or low-health effects. Numeric Ki activation cost is left null because current direct evidence reviewed here does not establish a reliable numeric Ki cost.

records.name: Hyper Movement
records.mechanics_notes: Evasive Skill that teleports to an opponent and attacks from the opposite side/behind depending on relative facing; it can also be used after knocking an opponent away. Current evidence establishes a 200 Stamina cost and TP Medal Shop acquisition. Ki cost is not applicable as the activation resource for this evasive and is therefore not converted from the Stamina cost.

validation.policy: Preserve null where a numeric Ki activation cost is not established; do not infer Ki costs from Stamina costs or class conventions.
